answer: Each challenge commits to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse whose unpredictable, publicly verifiable output is revealed only after submissions close. Because the pulse remains unbiasable until drand aggregation, an agent cannot precompute answers, reuse an offline corpus, or cheaply spawn sybil identities; commit-reveal binding also fixes each attempt. Whether referencing a horizon, knoll, or onyx, the task therefore resists mass farming and rewards accountable participation.
